_comment: The core ranges below are the maintained split manifest. Historical artifacts in results/ used older ranges and judges; see docs/review.md. All Alpaca core ranges refer to the shared empty-input and clean-instruction filter.
alpaca_source: tatsu-lab/alpaca [train], empty-input rows only, filter via experiment_1/utils._harmless_instruction_is_clean

experiment_2_refusal_direction.purpose: d_hat extraction (DiffMean) — disjoint from sweep eval
experiment_2_refusal_direction.note: registry updated 2026-05-07 to match results/qwen3-14b/refusal_direction/meta.json:n_harmful=256 (training pool extended to 256 paired prompts post-cascade); legacy SWEEP_HARMFUL_N constant referenced 100 prompts and is retained for cross-reference

experiment_3_guardrail_heads.purpose: DLA per-head onto d_hat at canonical L_read; reuses Exp.2 causal-sweep held-out pool so heads are scored on the same prompts that defined L_read

experiment_5_styled_pools.alpaca_pool: preferred from experiment_1 baseline_alpaca.jsonl, else load_dataset

experiment_6_topic_2x2.note: Rebuild before rerunning. Historical [200:250) overlaps the 256-prompt direction training pool.

experiment_7_policy_validity.note: Future runs use the canonical Alpaca filter. Historical builder used unfiltered instruction rows, so its indices were not comparable.

experiment_8.purpose: binary refusal vs N (split out of experiment_2 in step 1)

overlap_warnings: Historical experiment_6 harmless_mundane Alpaca[200:250) overlaps direction training Alpaca[0:256); the old claim that this leak was fixed is stale.
Historical experiment_7 used a different Alpaca filter. Its row numbers do not identify the canonical filtered slice claimed in the old manifest.
Historical experiment_5 harmless_plain selection did not exclude the harmless direction-training pool; rebuild with the new exclusion before evaluating.
Matched-direction pools and exploratory evaluation pools need exact prompt comparisons before claiming out-of-sample validity.
Experiments 6 and 7 share harmful evaluation prompts with the core test split; they are not independent replications.
